parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (TLV70233DBVR: 260 mV p.5 vs TLV74333PDBVR: 125 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TLV70233DBVR requires Vin,min >= 2 V (p.4) vs 1.4 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: TLV70233DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV74333PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because dropout voltage headroom differs (135 mV / 2.1x); Vin,min floor rises 0.6 V. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.5 °C on TLV70233DBVR (θJA 249.2 °C/W) vs 58.2 °C on TLV74333PDBVR (θJA 228.4 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1x ratio (35 µA (p.5) vs 34 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TLV70233DBVR "EN Sequencing Limit (VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V) & Unlimited PMOS Reverse-Current Body Diode" (p.4) and TLV74333PDBVR "EN Abs Max Strictly Capped at VIN + 0.3 V & No Internal EN Pulldown (Unlike TLV755P / TLV757P)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TLV70233DBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV (SOT-23-5)) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TLV74333PDBVR when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 125 mV dropout. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
